name: Drawer
label: Drawer
description: An edge-anchored panel that slides in from any side, modal by default or resting beside a live page, for filter panels, detail views, and mobile navigation.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Callback when the drawer requests to close

props.name: title
props.description:
Drawer title.
Note: this shadows the native `title` tooltip attribute, which Drawer does not expose.

props.name: heading
props.description:
Content shown in place of the title text, such as a site's logo. The
`title` still names the dialog, read by assistive tech from a visually
hidden heading.

props.name: footer
props.description: Optional footer slot — typically a row of Buttons

props.name: side
props.description:
Edge the panel slides in from. `left` and `right` are the screen's
edges in any reading direction; `start` and `end` follow it, so a
`start` drawer opens on the left in English and on the right in Arabic.

props.name: size
props.description: Panel size along the axis it slides on

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Whether ESC, scrim click, and the close button can dismiss

props.name: modal
props.description:
Whether the drawer takes over the page. `true` (the default) draws the
scrim, traps focus, locks scroll and makes the page behind inert. `false`
leaves the page live beside the panel, for a detail view that follows a
list: no scrim, no trap, and a press outside never closes it. Focus still
moves into the panel on open; on close it returns to the opener only if
it is still inside the panel.

props.name: layout
props.description:
How the panel meets the edge. `flush` (the default) runs to the edge with
a hairline on the side facing the page; `floating` holds the panel off
every edge as a raised, rounded card.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the close button.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes — applied to the portal container, not the panel

rows.text: Moves to the next control inside, and from the last back to the first. Focus never reaches the page behind.
Moves to the previous control inside, and from the first to the last.
Closes it and returns focus to what opened it.
